messages:
sophie: Quick thread  can we stitch a vendor roadmap so H100 / H200 / MI300 / Gaudi launches don't collide across marketplace GA, SI demos, and press? Need a lightweight matrix and any regional hard-blocks.

kiran: Ill own marketplace capacity mapping. Will check per-region reservation caps and embargo windows. ETA EOD Wed.

drew: SI note: partners frequently request exclusive demo lanes. Recommend reserving 1-2 exclusives/vendor but keep them outside press quiet windows.

mika: Comms: APAC wants a hard 72h quiet window; EU 48h; US 24h advisory. Also need a waiver flow for exceptions.

announce-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.company/docs/partners/roadmap-stitch-v1 - reviewers: kiran, mika.

sophie: Can someone drop a tiny matrix (region, primary, fallback, press-risk)? Keep it to 4 rows.

kiran: Draft:
```
region,primary,fallback,press-risk
us-east,h100,h200,medium
eu-west,mi300,h200,low
apac-south,h100,mi300,high
emea-south,gaudi,mi300,medium
```

drew: Ops: need fallback image tags `redwood/fallback:mi300-quant-v1` and `redwood/fallback:h200-slim`. Canary rule: switch if p95 latency > 300ms for 5m. Per-tenant overrides must remain possible.

mika: I'll author the embargo playbook + waiver template and start a PR.

kiran: Found one risk: gaudi driver sign-off pending for eu-west next Tue. If delayed, expect a 3-5 day regional availability hit. Marked as "firmware-risk" in the doc.

sophie: Action items summary:
- Kiran: region quotas + final matrix (EOD Wed)
- Drew: validate fallback images & canary route (EOD Fri)
- Mika: PR embargo playbook + waiver (EOD Fri)
- Sophie: coordinate exec readout after matrix locked

mika: Question: hard block in APAC only or global? I suggest hard block APAC, advisory elsewhere.

drew: Agree. Also will prototype routing logic this week and confirm image builds.

announce-bot: Task created: /tasks/50211 - "gaudi eu-west driver sign-off watch" assigned to hw-ops. Due: next-wed.

sophie: Great. Recheck in 48h and flag any slip >48h immediately so we can negotiate partner dates. Thanks everyone.
